title: Soft Pocket Pitas
description: Soft Pocket Pitas made from a small batch of scratch dough.

steps.title: Mix the dough
steps.text: Combine {bf}, {ww}, {water}, {oil}, {yeast}, {salt}. Use room-temperature liquids and softened fat. Mix until no dry flour remains.

steps.title: Develop the dough
steps.text: Knead 6–8 minutes until smooth. For wet dough, fold in the bowl with damp hands.

steps.title: Let rise
steps.text: Cover and let rise 45–75 minutes at room temperature until about doubled.

steps.title: Shape
steps.text: Divide in four and roll each evenly to ¼ inch thick. Keep covered while the baking sheet heats.

steps.title: Proof
steps.text: Cover and proof 15–25 minutes until puffy; a light fingertip dent should return slowly.

steps.title: Heat the oven
steps.text: Preheat the Samsung oven to 475°F on conventional Bake.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Transfer two rounds at a time to a preheated inverted sheet; bake until inflated and lightly spotted. Wrap in a towel immediately. Allow 5–10 minutes per batch; verify 195°F at the center of a test piece.

steps.title: Cool
steps.text: Cool on a rack for 10 minutes under a clean towel for a softer finish.

notes: Make ahead: weigh the dry ingredients the evening before. Freezer-Friendly Verdict: Yes. Cool completely and freeze sliced or individually wrapped for up to 2 months. Fridge reheat: wrap a serving in a damp towel and microwave for 15–25 seconds. Freezer reheat: thaw wrapped, then warm the same way. Serve with soup or gravy for a softer bite. Allow about 1–2 hours for rising and proofing in addition to mixing and baking. Estimated nutrition per serving (1/4 of recipe): 249 kcal, 8.6 g protein, 46.1 g total carbohydrate, 2.4 g fat, 4.2 g fiber, 295 mg sodium.
